title: Comparison of measures from open subsets: if μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0, ν is finite on compact subsets of the open set U, and μ(V) ≤ ν(V) for every open V ⊆ U, then μ ≤ ν
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let μ, ν be measures on the Borel σ-algebra of ℝ^P (Mathlib Measure (Euclid P), evaluated on arbitrary subsets as outer measures). Assume (i) μ(ℝ^P ∖ U) = 0; (ii) ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; (iii) μ(V) ≤ ν(V) for every open V ⊆ U. Then μ ≤ ν, i.e. μ(E) ≤ ν(E) for every E ⊆ ℝ^P (equivalently, for every Borel E). No finiteness of μ on compact sets and no local finiteness of ν near the boundary of U or outside U is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → μ Uᶜ = 0 → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ν K < ∞) → (∀ V : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen V → V ⊆ U → μ V ≤ ν V) → μ ≤ ν
